proposals.before: As educational commissioner of Shuntian he rooted out abuses and ran a strict administration; during his tenure he was promoted repeatedly, eventually to grand tutor and grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
proposals.after: As educational commissioner of Shuntian he rooted out abuses and ran a strict administration; during his tenure he was promoted repeatedly, eventually to Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent and academician of the Grand Secretariat.
proposals.reason: 詹事 is not grand tutor and 內閣學士 is not grand secretary (大學士); these are standard Qing office mistranslations.

decisions.reason: s0122 has 授勞崇光總督; 勞 is Lao, so 勞崇光 is Lao Chongguang. Luo is a mistranslation of the surname; the proposed idiomatic corrects only that name.
The same Chinese 勞崇光 requires Lao Chongguang in the literal field. Luo misreads 勞; the proposed replacement is accurate and otherwise unchanged.

s0005 has 累擢詹事、內閣學士. 詹事 is Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent, not grand tutor (太傅/太子太傅); 內閣學士 is academician of the Grand Secretariat, not grand secretary (大學士). The proposed titles restore the Qing offices.

s0140 opens with 論曰, already rendered as the leading Commentary: label; repeating The commentary says: invents a second speech frame not in the Chinese. Removing that duplicate leaves the historian’s judgment intact.
